== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi (V) (Virtual Block 1) (Errata)]] (<code>1210_107</code>, Virtual Block 1 slip 107), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 1 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB1-107-Obi_Wan_Kenobi.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB1-L-obiwankenobi-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi (V) (Virtual Block 1)]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee Virtual Cards [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Master List (Light Side)], official text as of 27 April 2013 (Internet Archive).
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Obi-Wan's game text may not be canceled and he may never be targeted by cards that capture. Unless another Jedi present, may Force drain here regardless of Objective restrictions. Immune to attrition < 5 (< 8 if with a Dark Jedi).”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71): the card's own Virtual Legacy card <code>1001_L5764</code> (printed frame, Decipher art <code>1_21</code>, title, lore, icons, slip number 107, Virtual Block 1 set mark) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
